root.command:
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl', N'PillLabel') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl ADD PillLabel NVARCHAR(20) NULL, PillColour NVARCHAR(20) NULL;
EXEC(N' UPDATE dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl SET PillLabel = CASE InvoiceTypeID WHEN 2 THEN N''Delivery note'' WHEN 3 THEN N''Dispatch note'' WHEN 4 THEN N''Gift'' WHEN 5 THEN N''Cash receipt'' WHEN 6 THEN N''Sample'' END, PillColour = CASE InvoiceTypeID WHEN 2 THEN N''#6f42c1'' WHEN 3 THEN N''#0d6efd'' WHEN 4 THEN N''#d63384'' WHEN 5 THEN N''#198754'' WHEN 6 THEN N''#fd7e14'' END WHERE InvoiceTypeID BETWEEN 2 AND 6;'); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl', N'InvoiceTypeID') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl ADD InvoiceTypeID INT NULL CONSTRAINT FK_RecurringOrdersTbl_InvoiceTypeID REFERENCES dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl (InvoiceTypeID); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.OrdersTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.OrdersTbl', N'InvoiceTypeID') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.OrdersTbl ADD InvoiceTypeID INT NULL CONSTRAINT FK_OrdersTbl_InvoiceTypeID REFERENCES dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl (InvoiceTypeID); END

IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl', N'InvoiceTypeID') IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE r SET r.InvoiceTypeID = ISNULL(it.InvoiceTypeID, 1) FROM dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl r LEFT JOIN dbo.ContactsAccInfoTbl a ON a.ContactID = r.ContactID LEFT JOIN dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl it ON it.InvoiceTypeID = a.InvoiceTypeID WHERE r.InvoiceTypeID IS NULL; END

IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.OrdersTbl', N'InvoiceTypeID') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl', N'InvoiceTypeID') IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE o SET o.InvoiceTypeID = COALESCE(ro.InvoiceTypeID, it.InvoiceTypeID, 1) FROM dbo.OrdersTbl o LEFT JOIN dbo.ContactsAccInfoTbl a ON a.ContactID = o.ContactID LEFT JOIN dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl it ON it.InvoiceTypeID = a.InvoiceTypeID OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 r.InvoiceTypeID FROM dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl r WHERE r.ContactID = o.ContactID AND ISNULL(r.Enabled, 0) = 1 ORDER BY r.RecurringOrderID ) ro WHERE o.InvoiceTypeID IS NULL AND ISNULL(o.Done, 0) = 0; END

SELECT it.InvoiceTypeID, it.InvoiceTypeDesc, it.PillLabel, it.PillColour, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.RecurringOrdersTbl r WHERE r.InvoiceTypeID = it.InvoiceTypeID) AS RecurringOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.OrdersTbl o WHERE o.InvoiceTypeID = it.InvoiceTypeID AND ISNULL(o.Done, 0) = 0) AS OpenOrders FROM dbo.InvoiceTypesTbl it ORDER BY it.InvoiceTypeID;
